description: Harden rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path to insert frontmatterBody verbatim via a replacer function instead of a replacement string.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes:
WARNING [test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts:179]: The new regression test does not actually discriminate the bug it targets. Against the pre-fix string-form code, `$&` expands to the whole matched fence (which itself contains `note: "matched $& and group $1"`), so the corrupted, fence-duplicated output STILL satisfies all three `.toContain()` assertions (verified empirically: OLD output = '...note: "matched ---
name: subagent-implementer
note: "matched $& and group $1"
--- and group $1"...'). The test passes green even when the feature is broken, violating criterion #2 (tests-with-meaningful-assert). Strengthen it to fail against the buggy form, e.g. assert the full expected string with `toBe(...)`, assert the note substring occurs exactly once, or assert `not.toContain('matched ---')`.

userStories.title: Insert frontmatterBody verbatim in rewriteFrontmatterEffort
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need rewriteFrontmatterEffort's insert path to insert the captured frontmatterBody literally so that any $-sequences ($&, $1, $$) in the body are never reinterpreted by the String.prototype.replace engine, closing a latent footgun.
acceptanceCriteria: In rewriteFrontmatterEffort's insert path (src/templates/frontmatter.ts), the second argument to content.replace is a replacer function that returns the assembled fence string, NOT a replacement string, so `$`-sequences in frontmatterBody are inserted literally. [oracle: file-assert grep -Eq 'content\.replace\(/\^---.*/, *\(\) *=>' src/templates/frontmatter.ts]

A test in test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts asserts that a frontmatterBody containing $-sequences (e.g. `$&`, `$1`) with no existing effort: line is inserted verbatim (the output still contains the literal `$&` / `$1` text and the new effort: line). [oracle: grep -Eq '[$]&|[$]1' test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]

The three existing rewriteFrontmatterEffort behaviors (rewrite existing line, insert when absent, no-op without a fence) are otherwise unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/templates/frontmatter.ts, rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path (lines 83-87). Only the insert branch is affected; the existing-line branch (line 80) uses a static template literal `$1 ${newEffort}` where $1 is intentional and must stay. Replacement-function form: content.replace(/^---\r?\n[\s\S]*?\r?\n---/, () => updatedFence). A no-arg arrow is sufficient (return value is inserted verbatim, MDN: 'the string returned by the function is used as the replacement'). Test lives in test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts under the existing rewriteFrontmatterEffort describe block; input must have a frontmatter fence, NO existing effort: line, and a body/key value containing $& and $1 so the insert path runs. Gotcha (issue CAM-317): agent frontmatter is controlled content so live risk is nil; this is latent-footgun hardening. Source: cam/issue-87. noUncheckedIndexedAccess: fenceMatch[1] is already guarded via `?? ''`.
